findings.label: Submit button pre-disabled on pristine forms
findings.description: Deposit form submit button is disabled on page load even if all required fields are legitimately empty. This forces the user to trigger validation on at least one required field before they can see why submit is disabled. Recommend validating only on touch or showing disabled-reason hints.

findings.label: Filter pill + search result count asymmetry
findings.description: Result count updates only when pills are clicked, not when search text alone changes. Result count line should refresh on both pill click and search input change to stay in sync with list re-render.

findings.label: Validation icon rendering inefficiency
findings.description: Icons are created and appended to field parent elements every time setFieldState() runs. If setFieldState() is called multiple times (e.g., on repeated input events), existing icon will be removed and a new one appended, causing DOM thrashing. Consider creating icon elements once per field during form init and toggling visibility/content instead of recreating.
